name: ragnhild

image_processing.note: Use ruby-vips for contact sheets, resizing, crops, sample grading, and image QA; fall back to ImageMagick only when libvips is unavailable. Apply postpro to generated samples, not to the training photos.

current_strengths: phone-camera realism with natural skin detail
current_risks: only 17 curated images after removing the excluded selfie
many near-duplicate frames from the same videos
dominant white cap and striped outfit may bind to identity
limited indoor, profile, studio, low-light, and lens variety
recommended_v2_additions: 8-12 close portraits across neutral, smile, and candid expressions
6-10 three-quarter and profile portraits without hat
6-10 waist-up or full-body photos in different outfits
4-8 indoor window-light photos and 4-8 outdoor overcast photos
remove blurry frames, heavy filters, extreme wide-angle distortion, and unflattering stills

sample_review.generation_blocker: Local LoRA generation is blocked until the current Hugging Face account is authorized for black-forest-labs/FLUX.1-dev or a compatible local base model is installed.

rejected_outputs.reason: rejected by user because the face did not look like Ragnhild; removed from retained outputs

acceptance_criteria: face shape and proportions read as Ragnhild before any film grade
eyes, mouth, smile, resting expression, and candid expression all stay consistent
identity holds across close-up, three-quarter, outdoor, indoor, and video first-frame prompts
hat, striped shirt, high-angle framing, or a single source-video pose do not become mandatory identity tokens
postpro is applied only to approved generated samples
sample_review.next_training_bias: add more approved no-hat close portraits, profile and three-quarter portraits, indoor window-light shots, and varied outfits before judging v2 quality

source_review_outputs.note: Final source-derived analog profile set from curated Ragnhild frames. These are not LoRA generations; they are identity-faithful still-photo edits while FLUX-dev generation remains gated.
source_review_outputs.cleanup_policy: Keep final stills and one contact sheet only; do not retain temp grids, recursive postpro variants, or video snippets in the final profile set.

prompt_research_notes: Use the trigger word plainly and keep each validation prompt focused on one photographic test.
Keep identity and style disentangled: validate face shape before applying stronger film or cinematic looks.
Favor concrete photographic nouns over hype: open shade, north-window light, catchlights, muted blacks, highlight rolloff, fine grain.
Use repeated seeds and varied prompts during training review to see whether identity holds as context changes.
Each future generated photo must test a different photographic world: lens, location, lighting, film stock, color grade, and mood should vary while preserving exact Ragnhild identity.

video_recipe.strategy: generate locked hero stills first, then use image-to-video shots stitched together instead of one long generation
video_recipe.identity_method: use the best ragnhild_v2 still as first-frame/reference input for each shot
